candidateOccurrences.sourceText: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, saying: “Your brother Israel says: You know all the travail that has happened to us;
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: These are the waters of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with the LORD, and he was sanctified in them.
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: how our fathers went down into Egypt, and we lived in Egypt a long time. The Egyptians mistreated us and our fathers.
candidateOccurrences.relationshipNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に場所名が明記される。

candidateOccurrences.sourceText: Edom said to him, “You shall not pass through me, lest I come out with the sword against you.”
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: “Please let us pass through your land. We will not pass through field or through vineyard, neither will we drink from the water of the wells. We will go along the king’s highway. We will not turn away to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed your border.”
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: The children of Israel said to him, “We will go up by the highway; and if we drink your water, I and my livestock, then I will give its price. Only let me, without doing anything else, pass through on my feet.”
candidateOccurrences.relationshipNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に場所名が明記される。

candidateOccurrences.sourceText: He said, “You shall not pass through.” Edom came out against him with many people, and with a strong hand.
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: The children of Israel said to him, “We will go up by the highway; and if we drink your water, I and my livestock, then I will give its price. Only let me, without doing anything else, pass through on my feet.”
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border, so Israel turned away from him.

candidateOccurrences.sourceText: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron in Mount Hor, by the border of the land of Edom, saying,
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: They traveled from Kadesh, and the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: “Aaron shall be gathered to his people; for he shall not enter into the land which I have given to the children of Israel, because you rebelled against my word at the waters of Meribah.
candidateOccurrences.relationshipNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に場所名が明記される。

candidateOccurrences.sourceText: They traveled from Mount Hor by the way to the Red Sea, to go around the land of Edom. The soul of the people was very discouraged because of the journey.
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: The LORD listened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities. The name of the place was called Hormah.
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: The people spoke against God and against Moses: “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? For there is no bread, there is no water, and our soul loathes this disgusting food!”
candidateOccurrences.relationshipNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に場所名が明記される。

candidateOccurrences.sourceText: Edom shall be a possession. Seir, his enemy, also shall be a possession, while Israel does valiantly.
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: I see him, but not now. I see him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob. A scepter will rise out of Israel, and shall strike through the corners of Moab, and crush all the sons of Sheth.
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: Out of Jacob shall one have dominion, and shall destroy the remnant from the city.”
candidateOccurrences.relationshipNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に場所名が明記される。

candidateOccurrences.sourceText: They traveled from Kadesh, and encamped in Mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: They traveled from Ezion Geber, and encamped at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: Aaron the priest went up into Mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.
candidateOccurrences.relationshipNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に場所名が明記される。

candidateOccurrences.sourceText: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom, and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward.
